name: smwmusic-mrs-estacion-setting-off-departures-dream
title: Mrs. Estacion - Setting Off ~ Departures Dream
description: The lovely stage 2 theme from Mrs. Estacion, an off-brand clone of Touhou. As its name implies, this song suits any form of adventuring level, maybe with a bit of emotion in it. I always picture a sunny summer sky alongisde a bus ride through the wind when listening to this song. I'm particularly proud of the @5 Reed Romance around 0:50. Also, that piano was a pain to transcribe due to how muffled it gets at parts in the original, but I guess that's Touhou music for ya. :P
